title: Privacy Policy
heading: Shree Shyam Small Growth Foundation
intro: Shree Shyam Small Growth Foundation ("the Foundation", "we", "our", or "us") is committed to protecting the privacy and personal information of our members, beneficiaries, donors, website visitors, and other stakeholders. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your information when you use our website or services.

informationWeCollect.l2: Website Information :- IP Address, Browser Type, Device Information, Cookies and website usage data

dataSecurity.heading: Data Security
dataSecurity.l1: We take reasonable administrative, technical, and organizational measures to protect personal information against unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or destruction. While we work to safeguard your data, no method of electronic storage or internet transmission can be guaranteed to be completely secure.
